question.text: From the point <math><mi>A</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> on the circle <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> a chord <math><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></math> is drawn and extended from point <math><mi>B</mi></math> to a point <math><mi>M</mi></math> such that <math><mi>A</mi><mi>M</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The perimeter of the locus of <math><mi>M</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi><mi>π</mi></math> units. Then, the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>p</mi></math> is

solution.text:
The equation of the given circle is
x2+y2+4x-6y+9=0…….i
Also, given that, AM=2AB
or AB=BM
Let, the coordinates of M be h,k.
Then, B is the midpoint of AM. Therefore,
B≡0+h2,3+k2≡h2,k+32
As B lies on the circle, we have, from i,
h2+k2+8h-6k+9=0
⇒ locus is a circle with radius 4
⇒ the perimeter of the locus is 8π units

⇒p=8
